reels.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses the 'holy grail' of AI: open-ended discovery. It appeals to a broad audience curious about whether AI can truly innovate, matching the 'mechanistic_interpretability' (highest velocity) interest as we explore how the agent makes scientific leaps.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Can AI actually discover new science, or is it just repeating what we've already taught it?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: The 'Lego Master Builder' analogy—how AI navigates an infinite pile of bricks to find a brand new structure no one programmed it to build.
